remarks: The ever-popular Leefair condo complex is the setting of this delightful and renovated end unit. A large Living Room with stone fireplace is open to the Dining Area and flows into the eat-in Kitchen with granite countertops and peninsula, as well as stainless appliances....a chef's dream. There is also a Study with a bay window. A Laundry area is on the main level, which is perfect since your linens and towels are on this floor. Another plus is the hard-to-find main level Primary Suite with ceiling fan, a walk-in closet and a massive redone bathroom. Hardwood floors throughout the first floor.  Additional square footage in the walk-out Lower Level includes a spacious Family Room with a ceiling fan and a bank of sliders to the private and oversized patio area. A second Bedroom has close access to the renovated hall bath. There is also a den on this floor. Tons of storage and a hook-up for an additional Laundry, if needed is all on this level.  The two-car garage is pristine and provides entry right into the main floor. Ask me about the secret closet downstairs. Move-in ready unit just waiting for its next lucky owners.

facts.laundryLoc: Main Level W/D +hookup in Lower Level
